name: Wonderland
short: The Wonderland guidebook: .wld command guide, server map and mod cheat sheet, plus the intro form and member stats.
description: `.wonderland` (short: `.wld`, also `/wonderland menu`) opens a private dropdown guide to everything the server's bots do: Economy & Shop, Casino, Games & Activities, Profile & Levels, Community & Events, Music & Fun, a Server Map of every channel, and a mods-only cheat sheet. Each command line only shows while that command exists on the bot, so the guide never lists something that was renamed or unloaded. `.wld search <word>` finds a command, `.wld stats` shows your record across every game, and `.wld publish #channel` posts (and later refreshes) the same guide in a channel. This package also carries IntroForm (`.introform`), IntroCleanup (`.introcleanup`) and MyStats (`.mystats`), so one install covers them all.
end_user_data_statement: The guide stores only the channel and message IDs of any published copy. IntroForm stores, per guild, the intros channel ID and each member's submitted intro answers and the ID of their posted intro message, until the member deletes their intro or leaves. IntroCleanup stores the intros and log channel IDs. MyStats stores nothing.
install_msg: Moving from the separate cogs? First run `[p]unload mystats introform introcleanup`, then `[p]cog install evac-cogs wonderland` and `[p]load wonderland`. Saved intro-form and cleanup settings carry over. Try `[p]wld`, then `[p]wld publish #server-guide` when you want the guide posted.
author: evacfk
